Name: Siasz's Sebastian Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description: I updated all of his images where I fixed his hair, and eyes a bit more because both were bothering me. I also added complete new portraits for him while hes working on his motorcycle. I also wanted to note that the cigarette pack design is just something I came up with, I wanted it to be determined by you all if you'd like to think of it as cigarettes, or a form of CBD.  I hope you all enjoy the portraits!

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into zipped folder, copy and paste image into portraiture mod where all your other images are located at. If there is other Sebastian images it will ask if you'd like to replace the files. Click yes.
